tools.name: app_overview
tools.title: Pocket Track overview
tools.description: Describe what Pocket Track does, the screens a teacher can use, and how M-Pesa deposits are reconciled to students.

tools.name: parse_mpesa_message
tools.title: Parse M-Pesa message
tools.description: Read a raw M-Pesa confirmation SMS and extract the transaction code, amount in KES, sender name and normalised sender phone number. Read-only: it never moves money and never changes any Pocket Track record.

message.description: The raw M-Pesa confirmation SMS text, exactly as received.

tools.name: list_students
tools.title: List students and balances
tools.description: List the signed-in teacher's students with admission number, class, parent phone and current pocket-money balance in KES. Read-only.

search.description: Optional filter matched against student name, admission number or parent phone.

tools.name: record_mpesa_message
tools.title: Record an M-Pesa deposit
tools.description: Take a raw M-Pesa confirmation SMS and file it in Pocket Track for the signed-in teacher. If the sender's phone matches a student's parent phone, that student's balance is credited; otherwise the message is parked in the teacher's inbox for manual placement. Duplicate transaction codes are ignored.

message.description: The raw M-Pesa confirmation SMS text, exactly as received.

tools.name: list_unmatched_deposits
tools.title: List unplaced deposits
tools.description: List deposits waiting in the signed-in teacher's inbox because the sender's phone number does not match any student's parent phone. Read-only.

tools.name: place_unmatched_deposit
tools.title: Place an unplaced deposit
tools.description: Credit a waiting deposit from the signed-in teacher's inbox to a specific student, using the deposit id from list_unmatched_deposits and the student id from list_students.
